roadmap.title: Follow the story through Malicos
roadmap.description: Play on any difficulty through the return to Dathomir and the Malicos fight after Ilum. Scan new enemies, plant seeds whenever you return to the Mantis, and use combat skills as they unlock.

roadmap.title: Finish planting and recruit the full crew
roadmap.description: After Malicos, collect and plant the remaining terrarium seeds before the long collection sweep. Recruit the Bogling and defeat the remaining bounty-hunter types.

roadmap.title: Finish the story and sweep the planets
roadmap.description: Open the Bogano vault with the Astrium, then finish the Fortress Inquisitorius mission. Continue the existing save after the ending to collect the remaining chests, secrets, stim upgrades, and Cordova logs. Complete exploration, buy missing skills, and check the mature terrarium.

achievements.description: Kick a phillak that has kicked you
achievements.summary: Kick the same phillak after surviving its rear kick.

steps.text: Buy @mechanic{Evasive Kick} and approach a @enemy{phillak} in @loc{Windswept Ruins} on Zeffo.
Stand behind the phillak and let its rear kick hit you. Evade without moving, then immediately press Attack to kick the same phillak.

achievements.description: Collect all chests and secrets
achievements.summary: Open all 107 chests and collect all 32 secrets.

guide.context: Locked chests need @item{Scomp Link}, repaired at the workbench inside the @loc{Weathered Monument} statue on Zeffo after you learn @mechanic{Force Push}. The holomap counts chests and secrets per region, and everything stays open after the story. This list waits until you have each ability an item needs.

collectibles.name: Secret: Force Essence
collectibles.location: @loc{Bogdo Sinkholes}, fan room across the pipes
collectibles.method: From the meditation point by the locked door, cross the pipes to the room behind the fans. Slow each fan with @mechanic{Force Slow}, including the one in the water, and take the Force Echo on the far side.

collectibles.name: Lightsaber Emitter (Eno Cordova)
collectibles.method: Go left past the shortcut and jump the small gap to the chest.

collectibles.name: Poncho (Bogano Dawn)
collectibles.method: After killing the Bog Rat, turn back toward the drop you came down. The chest sits in the rock face.

collectibles.name: Lightsaber Switch (Valor & Wisdom II)
collectibles.method: After learning wall run at @loc{Subterranean Refuge}, cross the pipe and wall-run between the hanging metal wall and the rock wall down to the zipline.

collectibles.name: Lightsaber Sleeve (Valour & Wisdom II)
collectibles.method: Climb the vines to the top of the Great Divide and kill the @enemy{Splox}. Open the unlocked one of the two chests here; the locked one comes later.

collectibles.name: BD-1 Skin (Blue Leader)
collectibles.method: Leave the Mantis and check the stacked crates on the left side of the hangar.

collectibles.name: Poncho (Bravo)
collectibles.method: Go into the big bay past the landing platform. The chest is among crates in the far left corner.

collectibles.name: Secret: Stim Canister
collectibles.method: Where the second pair of @enemy{Scazz} attack, enter the cave beside the waterfall. Follow it to the dead end and open the gold chest.

collectibles.name: Lightsaber Emitter (Duty & Resolve)
collectibles.location: @loc{Derelict Hangar}, roof of the stone hut
collectibles.method: After the last stormtrooper group, go behind the stone hut near where you entered. Climb the metal ledge on its side to the roof.

collectibles.name: Outfit (Guardian)
collectibles.method: From the top of the stairs, face the lower level. Climb the metal overhang on the left onto a house roof.

collectibles.name: Lightsaber Sleeve (Duty & Resolve)
collectibles.method: From the previous roof, cross the pipe and follow the rooftops back to the upper level. Jump past the yellow metal cap to the chest.

collectibles.name: Lightsaber Material (Copper)
collectibles.method: Take the other path at the fork. After the second pipe crossing, jump to the platform on your left.

collectibles.name: Secret: Life Essence
collectibles.location: @loc{Gusty Bluffs}, passage past the upper turbines
collectibles.method: Slow the second turbine so its blade lifts you to the meditation point. Climb the slope, slow the next two turbines, cross, and scan the crates in the passage.

collectibles.name: Lightsaber Sleeve (Elemental Nature II)
collectibles.method: Climb the lowered cable. Before walking out on the pipe, turn around and jump up the grassy ledge. The chest is around the rock to the right.

collectibles.name: Lightsaber Switch (Duty & Resolve)
collectibles.method: Beat the @enemy{Scout Trooper Commander} and his partner, then look left.

collectibles.name: Lightsaber Material (Durasteel)
collectibles.location: @loc{Auger Pulverisers}, alcove inside the rock passage
collectibles.method: In the passage, slow the first pulverizer while it pushes outward. Run down its track and turn into the small alcove on the left near the end.

collectibles.name: Secret: Life Essence
collectibles.location: @loc{Auger Pulverisers}, stun baton on a lone platform
collectibles.method: Wall-run over the last pulverizer to the cliff meditation point. Cut the metal stakes behind it, drop onto the slowed pulverizer, and hop across the others to the platform.

collectibles.name: Mantis Paint Job (Starfighter)
collectibles.location: @loc{Auger Pulverisers}, metal ledge past the cables
collectibles.method: From the meditation point, swing across the cables and defeat the stormtroopers. The chest is on a small ledge on the left.

collectibles.name: Lightsaber Sleeve (Duty & Resolve II)
collectibles.method: From the meditation point, drop to the lowest level and go to the far right side.

collectibles.name: Secret: Force Essence
collectibles.location: @loc{Tomb of Eilram}, first puzzle room floor
collectibles.method: Turn on the two outer wind vents and let the sphere break the bars. Turn on the freed vent, then the last vent to push the sphere to the center. The floor rises with the Force Echo.

collectibles.name: Poncho (Outlander)
collectibles.location: @loc{Tomb of Eilram}, ledge across the chasm
collectibles.method: After the first sphere puzzle, slide down and grab the cable. Instead of the wall run, swing across the two cables on the opposite side to the far ledge.

collectibles.name: Lightsaber Material (Silvian Iron)
collectibles.location: @loc{Tomb of Eilram}, ledge with the broken Tomb Guardian
collectibles.method: After @mechanic{Force Push}, push the stone blocks in the room outside Eilram's chamber. Climb the last block to the ledge; the chest is left of the Force Echo.

collectibles.name: Secret: Force Essence
collectibles.location: @loc{Tomb of Eilram}, behind bars in the Skungus room
collectibles.method: Push the lone @enemy{Skungus} near the curved bars into them. The Force Echo is behind the bars.

collectibles.name: BD-1 Skin (Balmgrass)
collectibles.location: @loc{Tomb of Eilram}, alcove at the ceiling of the main chamber
collectibles.method: Push the sphere toward the bottom-left socket and slow it. Stand on the pillar before it rises and ride it to the alcove.

collectibles.name: Lightsaber Material (Osmiridium)
collectibles.location: @loc{Windswept Ruins}, top of the wind vents
collectibles.method: On the return visit, clear the stormtroopers and go up to the far right corner. Ride one vent to a ledge, then jump into the next vent to the chest.

collectibles.name: Poncho (Wayfarer)
collectibles.location: @loc{Ice Caves}, Scazz nest below the first meditation point
collectibles.method: Drop to the ledge under the first meditation point and continue down to the nest.

collectibles.name: Lightsaber Material (Cerakote)
collectibles.location: @loc{Ice Caves}, room with the door shortcut
collectibles.method: Open the chest on the left of the door shortcut.

collectibles.name: BD-1 Skin (Bestine)
collectibles.location: @loc{Ice Caves}, room with the door shortcut
collectibles.method: Open the chest on the right of the door shortcut.

collectibles.name: Poncho (Rainforest)
collectibles.method: After the AT-AT crash, check beneath the downed Imperial transport's wing beside the wreck.

collectibles.name: Lightsaber Material (Doonium)
collectibles.location: @loc{Imperial Refinery}, mud by the second meditation point
collectibles.method: Outside the refinery building, defeat the stormtroopers and @enemy{Wyyyschokks}. The chest is right of the @item{Bonshyyyr} seed in the mud.

collectibles.name: Secret: Force Essence
collectibles.location: @loc{Imperial Refinery}, root passage above the stormtrooper fight
collectibles.method: From the meditation point, follow the upper ledge into the dark root passage. The Force Echo is on a stormtrooper corpse.

collectibles.name: Poncho (Commando)
collectibles.method: Keep going a few steps along that ledge past the stormtrooper Force Echo.

collectibles.name: Secret: Life Essence
collectibles.location: @loc{Overgrown Pass}, toolbox behind a pipe shortcut
collectibles.method: Slide down into the pass and head back toward the refinery. Search behind the pipe you can push down.

collectibles.name: Secret: Force Echo
collectibles.method: Overcharge the console to spin the mixer, slow it, and run the pipes to the platform on the right. Swing along the overhead pipe, slow the two turbines, and reach the stormtrooper corpse.

collectibles.name: Mantis Paint Job (Occultation)
collectibles.method: Climb the statue with @mechanic{Scomp Link}. Wait for the pulverizer to extend fully, slow it, and run through it to the platform below left.

collectibles.name: Mantis Paint Job (Mercenary)
collectibles.location: @loc{Weathered Monument}, by the Royal Fluzz seed
collectibles.method: Return to where you scanned the @item{Royal Fluzz} seed and slice the locked chest.

collectibles.name: Lightsaber Switch (Duty & Resolve II)
collectibles.location: @loc{Weathered Monument}, locked door under the wall run
collectibles.method: Drop into the small settlement and slice open the door below the wall run.

collectibles.name: Mantis Paint Job (Charisma)
collectibles.location: @loc{Ancient Catacombs}, top of a wind vent
collectibles.method: After the dark corridor with the Scazz, ride the wind vent ahead up to the chest.

collectibles.name: Lightsaber Material (Arcetron)
collectibles.method: From the cable shortcut near the @enemy{Jotaz}, go left. Slow the gears, defeat the troopers beyond, and slice the chest.

collectibles.name: Secret: Force Echo
collectibles.method: After the @enemy{Rabid Jotaz}, push through its wall, cut the electrified cable, and take the elevator. The Force Echo is on a clone trooper corpse as you step off.

collectibles.name: Poncho (Hyper Shell)
collectibles.method: Leaving the Broken Wing, look left down the walkway. Jump the gap and wall-run to the chest.

collectibles.name: Secret: Life Essence
collectibles.location: @loc{Crash Site}, cave by the crashed ARC wing
collectibles.method: Climb the cable near the ARC wing into the cave. Overcharge the console, ride the pulverizers to the upper ledge, and scan the Zeffo skeleton.

collectibles.name: BD-1 Skin (Swoop)
collectibles.location: @loc{Crash Site}, phillak island under the Venator
collectibles.method: Swim to the island with the @enemy{phillaks} below the wreck. Slice the chest at the back.

collectibles.name: Secret: Life Essence
collectibles.method: Take the Force Echo on the clone trooper corpse after the engine tunnels.

collectibles.name: Mantis Paint Job (Greezy Money)
collectibles.location: @loc{Tomb of Miktrull}, far end of the outer path
collectibles.method: After the second meditation point, follow the path outside past the Tomb Guardian fight. Slice the chest next to the urn Force Echo.

collectibles.name: Lightsaber Material (Haysian Smelt)
collectibles.location: @loc{Tomb of Miktrull}, behind a breakable wall
collectibles.method: Enter the main chamber's upper floor, turn right, and climb a vine wall. Push open the farther left of the two breakable walls.

collectibles.name: Secret: Life Essence
collectibles.location: @loc{Tomb of Miktrull}, behind bars past the Scout Trooper ambush
collectibles.method: Push the @enemy{Skungus} just ahead into the iron bars to free the Force Echo.

collectibles.name: Secret: Force Essence
collectibles.location: @loc{Tomb of Miktrull}, above the phillak door
collectibles.method: Before raising the door with @mechanic{Force Pull}, lob a candle over it through the gap above. Raise the door, toss that candle at the roots behind it, and climb the vine wall.

collectibles.name: BD-1 Skin (Sumi)
collectibles.location: @loc{Tomb of Miktrull}, outside bridge below the third level
collectibles.method: From the meditation point, climb the vine wall and jump out onto the bridge. Pull the respawning candles behind you and throw them at the dead roots on the right.

collectibles.name: Mantis Paint Job (Zodiac Drifter)
collectibles.location: @loc{Tomb of Miktrull}, secret area off the third level
collectibles.method: Defeat the @enemy{Electrobaton Purge Trooper}, then pull down a vine and swing out. Burn the roots, turn off the magnet, and throw a candle through the statue's mouth.

collectibles.name: Poncho (Serape)
collectibles.method: Leave the spire and go to the dead end by the roots on your right.

collectibles.name: Lightsaber Material (Aurodium)
collectibles.method: Overcharge the console to drop the force field. Slow the fan, enter the vent, pull down a platform, climb, and slow the second fan.

collectibles.name: BD-1 Skin (Sundari Dawn)
collectibles.location: @loc{Cargo Pad}, right of the wrecked AT-AT ramp
collectibles.method: Walk down the ramp toward the AT-AT, turn right at the bottom, and slice the chest.

collectibles.name: Secret: Force Essence
collectibles.location: @loc{Forest Trench}, ledge right of the entrance
collectibles.method: Take the right-hand path, overcharge the console, and use @mechanic{Powered Zipline} to reach the ledge.

collectibles.name: Lightsaber Switch (Passion & Strength)
collectibles.method: Before going down to the Shadowlands, return to the maze with the @enemy{Slyyyg} and fire beetles and slice the chest.

collectibles.name: Lightsaber Sleeve (Passion & Strength II)
collectibles.method: After sliding down to the second half, open the door on your right.

collectibles.name: Lightsaber Switch (Passion & Strength II)
collectibles.method: After the @enemy{Purge Trooper Commander}, step outside and wall-run down behind you. Push open the wall.

collectibles.name: Lightsaber Material (Crodium)
collectibles.method: After the long zipline into the lake, swim to the platform on your left.

collectibles.name: Lightsaber Sleeve (Passion & Strength)
collectibles.method: Swim right around the lake to the far corner and climb behind the wreck.

collectibles.name: Poncho (The Guardian)
collectibles.location: @loc{Kyyyalstaad Basin}, ledges above the meditation point
collectibles.method: Face the lake from the meditation point and climb the ledges on the left. Slice the chest left of the vine wall.

collectibles.name: Poncho (Shyyyo)
collectibles.location: @loc{Origin Lake}, above the first meditation point
collectibles.method: Swim to the lung plant on a ledge and launch up. Take the angled lung plant to the ledge over the meditation point.

collectibles.name: Lightsaber Switch (Peace & Justice II)
collectibles.location: @loc{Origin Lake}, underwater below the first lung plant
collectibles.method: After getting the @item{Underwater Breather}, dive under the first lung plant you used.

collectibles.name: Lightsaber Material (Electrum-Plated)
collectibles.location: @loc{Origin Lake}, underwater below a rock formation
collectibles.method: Swim right from the previous chest.

collectibles.name: Lightsaber Material (Duralium)
collectibles.location: @loc{Origin Lake}, bottom of the narrow underwater passage
collectibles.method: Leave the tunnel and dive down the narrow passage.

collectibles.name: Secret: Stim Canister
collectibles.location: @loc{Origin Lake}, ledge past the sunken gunship
collectibles.method: Swim on through the passage and the wrecked gunship. Launch up three lung plants across from a vine wall to the gold chest.

collectibles.name: Lightsaber Sleeve (Valour & Wisdom)
collectibles.method: After the stormtroopers by the pool, swim across and slice the chest.

collectibles.name: Lightsaber Emitter (Peace & Justice)
collectibles.method: Swing across, climb the vine wall, and dive into the pool. Look left right away.

collectibles.name: Poncho (Recon)
collectibles.location: @loc{Deserted Village}, ledge off the mud slide
collectibles.method: After the @enemy{Electrohammer Purge Trooper}, drop onto the mud slide right of the bridge and jump off it to the ledge ahead.

collectibles.name: Lightsaber Material (Bronzium)
collectibles.method: After the mud slides drop you in the pool, swim underwater toward the exit.

collectibles.name: Poncho (Rover)
collectibles.method: After scanning the @item{Mushbloom} seed, turn left and look behind you.

collectibles.name: Poncho (Free Kashyyyk)
collectibles.method: Launch up both lung plants, turn around, and walk back along the long branch. Go right at the junction.

collectibles.name: Outfit (Pilot)
collectibles.location: @loc{Gnarled Heights}, branch off the hanging log
collectibles.method: Swing to the hanging log, climb halfway, and jump to the branch on the left.

collectibles.name: Mantis Paint Job (Perihelion)
collectibles.location: @loc{Gnarled Heights}, ledge after the fourth Shyyyo bird
collectibles.method: After healing the bird the fourth time, climb the nearby ledge and @mechanic{Jedi Flip} up to the next.

collectibles.name: Lightsaber Switch (Peace & Justice)
collectibles.method: After the boss, swim across the small lake toward the @loc{Imperial Refinery} and dive at the back.

collectibles.name: Mantis Paint Job (Bounty Hunter)
collectibles.location: @loc{Imperial Refinery}, column in the muddy water
collectibles.method: Ride the elevator shortcut up from @loc{Kyyyalstaad Falls} to the mixer room. Jedi Flip to the lone column.

collectibles.name: Lightsaber Material (Matte)
collectibles.location: @loc{Imperial Refinery}, sliceable door in the drill room
collectibles.method: Near the meditation point by the @enemy{Albino Wyyyschokk}, enter the room where you moved the drill. Climb the wall and slice the door, which shows green on the holomap.

collectibles.name: BD-1 Skin (Stygeon Prime)
collectibles.method: Cut the cords ahead of the previous chest.

collectibles.name: Lightsaber Emitter (Passion & Strength)
collectibles.location: @loc{Imperial Refinery}, path to the first meditation point
collectibles.method: On the @loc{Forest Trench} side of the refinery, slice the chest along the path leading to its meditation point.

collectibles.name: Lightsaber Material (Durite)
collectibles.method: Defeat the scout troopers, cross the bridge you knocked down, and slice the chest.

collectibles.name: Secret: Stim Canister
collectibles.location: @loc{Imperial Dig Site}, room behind a pushable wall
collectibles.method: From the bridge, ride the powered zipline and drop onto the platform below. Follow the pipe and push open the wall.

collectibles.name: Lightsaber Sleeve (Elemental Nature)
collectibles.location: @loc{Crash Site}, underwater right of the entrance
collectibles.method: Drop from the cable shortcut on the right and dive.

collectibles.name: Lightsaber Emitter (Elemental Nature)
collectibles.location: @loc{Crash Site}, underwater past the phillak island
collectibles.method: Dive just past the island with the two phillaks.

collectibles.name: Lightsaber Material (Polished Bronzium)
collectibles.method: From the phillak island, swim to the far left corner and dive beneath the red-painted scrap.

collectibles.name: BD-1 Skin (Grungio)
collectibles.location: @loc{Crash Site}, water right of the Jotaz circle
collectibles.method: Dive in on the right side of the circular area.

collectibles.name: Poncho Material (Fjord)
collectibles.location: @loc{Crash Site}, water left of the Jotaz circle
collectibles.method: Swim around to the other side of the circle and dive.

collectibles.name: Lightsaber Switch (Elemental Nature)
collectibles.location: @loc{Crash Site}, underwater left of the Ice Caves slope
collectibles.method: Dive below the rock face beside the slope up to @loc{Ice Caves}.

collectibles.name: Lightsaber Material (Orichalc)
collectibles.method: Take the elevator down and cross the first room. Dive into the flooded hallway on your side of the swinging pipe.

collectibles.name: Lightsaber Switch (Elemental Nature II)
collectibles.location: @loc{Venator Wreckage}, hole in the wall by the pool
collectibles.method: Jedi Flip up the wrecked engine to the new engine column and ride the ice slide into the pool. From the meditation point, swim far right through the hole.

collectibles.name: Secret: Force Essence
collectibles.location: @loc{Venator Wreckage}, platform off the second cable
collectibles.method: Swing left from the second cable over the water and Jedi Flip onto the platform.

collectibles.name: Lightsaber Material (Chromium)
collectibles.method: Slice the first of the three chests in the final room.

collectibles.name: BD-1 Skin (Cantonica)
collectibles.method: Slice the second chest in the final room.

collectibles.name: Poncho Material (Starfighter)
collectibles.method: Slice the third chest in the final room.

collectibles.name: Secret: Stim Canister
collectibles.location: @loc{Venator Wreckage}, platforms down to the Crash Site
collectibles.method: Leave the final room and drop down the platforms. Open the gold chest before reaching the bottom.

collectibles.name: Secret: Stim Canister
collectibles.method: Near the lower meditation point, defeat the Jotaz. From the far left edge, pull the vines and swing to the gold chest.

collectibles.name: BD-1 Skin (Yavin Prime)
collectibles.location: @loc{Upper Strangled Cliffs}, across from a wall run
collectibles.method: Climb up from @loc{Strangled Cliffs} and look right.

collectibles.name: Lightsaber Emitter (Magus)
collectibles.location: @loc{Upper Strangled Cliffs}, before the rock bridge
collectibles.method: Past the rope shortcut with three @enemy{Bane Back Spiders}, look right before crossing the bridge and slice the chest.

collectibles.name: Secret: Life Essence
collectibles.method: From the previous chest, push the crate down the ramp on the left of the bridge. Use it to reach the vines and drop behind the door.

collectibles.name: Mantis Paint Job (Racer)
collectibles.method: Exit the Nightbrother camp where a warrior and archer ambush you. The chest is on your right.

collectibles.name: Lightsaber Switch (Magus)
collectibles.method: After the second camp, follow the walkway above the meditation point and drop into the room. Look left.

collectibles.name: Secret: Life Essence
collectibles.location: @loc{Brother's Bastion}, walkway above the meditation point
collectibles.method: At the far exit, go left down the stairs past the workbench room. Climb the vines in the spider room.

collectibles.name: Lightsaber Sleeve (Power & Control)
collectibles.method: Near the end, ride the wooden lift behind the locked door.

collectibles.name: Poncho (Savannah)
collectibles.location: @loc{Swamp of Sacrifice}, cliff edge on the right path
collectibles.method: Go right at the junction, defeat the @enemy{Undead Nightsisters}, and slice the chest.

collectibles.name: Lightsaber Emitter (Power & Control)
collectibles.location: @loc{Swamp of Sacrifice}, by the vine wall
collectibles.method: Take the right path to the @enemy{Lesser Nydak} fight. Slice the chest near the vine wall.

collectibles.name: Lightsaber Switch (Power & Control II)
collectibles.method: Climb the vine wall, follow the roots, and drop down. The chest is in the open.

collectibles.name: Secret: Force Essence
collectibles.method: After beating @enemy{Gorgara}, return to the wall you were climbing. Look right at the top.

collectibles.name: Day of the Dianoga (BD-1 Skin)
collectibles.method: Walk through the statue's mouth to the small wooden bridge.

collectibles.name: Poncho (Vagabond)
collectibles.method: After swinging under the bridge, check the corners of the room on the left.

collectibles.name: Lightsaber Material (Dolovite)
collectibles.method: Go right and look left immediately.

collectibles.name: Mantis Paint Job (Aphelion)
collectibles.method: Push the crate to climb to the second floor of the blue hut and defeat the @enemy{Nightbrother Warrior}.

collectibles.name: Mantis Paint Job (Smuggler)
collectibles.location: @loc{Nightmare Ruins}, Tomb of Kujet entry hall
collectibles.method: When the doors close, look right into the corner behind you.

collectibles.name: Secret: Force Essence
collectibles.location: @loc{Shattered Lake}, ledge past the wall runs
collectibles.method: Take the gullies on the right and wall-run to the lone ledge.

collectibles.name: BD-1 Skin (Tibanna)
collectibles.method: After the crystal light puzzle, dive below the meditation point. Swim left past the geysers.

collectibles.name: Secret: Life Essence
collectibles.location: @loc{Crystal Caves}, high ledge in the main chamber
collectibles.method: Leave the room between the Jedi statues. Pull down the rope on the left and use it with the wall runs.

collectibles.name: Lightsaber Sleeve (Power & Control II)
collectibles.location: @loc{Crystal Caves}, room with two probe droids
collectibles.method: Destroy the droids and slice the chest in the left corner.

collectibles.name: Lightsaber Switch (Power & Control)
collectibles.method: Climb the ice wall and dive into the first pool. The chest is at the bottom right.

collectibles.name: Lightsaber Material (Duraplast)
collectibles.location: @loc{Imperial Trench}, top of the ice wall
collectibles.method: Swing to the meditation point and climb the ice wall on the left.

collectibles.name: Secret: Life Essence
collectibles.method: During the escape, jump to the ledge between the Jedi statues. Cut the crystals on the left, then wall-run and slide down.

collectibles.name: Poncho (Compañero)
collectibles.location: @loc{Shattered Lake}, top of the Jedi monument
collectibles.method: During the escape, squeeze through the passage and climb the ice wall. Cut the crystals.

collectibles.name: BD-1 Skin (Myrmidon)
collectibles.location: @loc{Nightmare Ruins}, ledge below the Nydak Alpha area
collectibles.method: After the @enemy{Nydak Alpha}, slide to the wall run. The chest is on the next ledge below.

collectibles.name: Poncho (Homestead)
collectibles.location: @loc{Nightmare Ruins}, ledge above the wall runs
collectibles.method: Climb the vine wall, defeat the group, and slice the chest by the climb.

collectibles.name: Outfit (Outlaw)
collectibles.method: Jump over from the archer's spot and pass two stone blocks. The chest is behind the second.

collectibles.name: Secret: Stim Canister
collectibles.location: @loc{Nightmare Ruins}, root above the tomb steps
collectibles.method: Climb the vine wall and walk out along the twisted root to the gold chest.

collectibles.name: Secret: Stim Canister
collectibles.location: @loc{Landing Pad}, rusted cage by the Bogling
collectibles.method: Push the sphere into the socket inside the cage. Rolling it along the concrete ramp helps.

collectibles.name: Lightsaber Sleeve (Peace & Justice II)
collectibles.location: @loc{Fractured Plain}, far edge of the plateau
collectibles.method: Climb the vine wall beside the meditation point and Jedi Flip to the plateau. Head toward the vault.

collectibles.name: Lightsaber Material (Neuranium)
collectibles.method: Go to the plateau's left end. Jump the gap by the rusted vaporator, wall-run around the rocks, and climb the vines.

collectibles.name: Mantis Paint Job (Republic)
collectibles.location: @loc{Bogdo Sinkholes}, fan in the rock wall
collectibles.method: Pull the raised bridge and swing on the rope. Jump off and slow the fan in the wall behind you in midair.

collectibles.name: Secret: Life Essence
collectibles.location: @loc{Bogdo Sinkholes}, back of Oggdo Bogdo's lair
collectibles.method: Take the Force Echo on the Bogling corpse.

collectibles.name: Poncho (Sumi)
collectibles.method: Slice the chest near the Bogling Force Echo.

collectibles.name: Outfit (Pathfinder)
collectibles.method: Take the left path past the meditation point, defeat the Splox, and wall-run to the amphitheater. Drop to the lower ledge from the top far left.

collectibles.name: Secret: Stim Canister
collectibles.method: Wall-run up from the meditation point and pull down the stone block above you.

collectibles.name: Secret: Life Essence
collectibles.location: @loc{Subterranean Refuge}, ledge past the two vines
collectibles.method: Swing on the two vines and angle left onto the wall run to reach the ledge. Follow the path.

collectibles.name: BD-1 Skin (Z'Gag Wave)
collectibles.method: Push the bridge down in the chasm on your right and slice the chest.

collectibles.name: Lightsaber Material (Corundum)
collectibles.method: Ride the elevator up and slice the locked chest beside the one you opened on your first visit.

collectibles.name: Lightsaber Switch (Eno Cordova)
collectibles.method: Drop into the room below and overcharge the console right of Cordova's bed.

collectibles.name: Lightsaber Emitter (Valour & Wisdom)
collectibles.method: Go right from the pulled-down bridge in the Great Divide. Dive near the first ledge.

collectibles.name: Lightsaber Switch (Valour & Wisdom)
collectibles.method: Swim underwater to the far end, behind the vines you climb out on.

collectibles.name: Secret: Force Essence
collectibles.location: @loc{Abandoned Workshop}, stairs out of the flooded room
collectibles.method: Slice the door on a landing of the stairs.

collectibles.name: Poncho (Offshore)
collectibles.method: Swing across the rope to the far side and defeat the three @enemy{Oggdos}. Go right along the cliff and slice the chest.

collectibles.name: Lightsaber Material (Lamina Steel)
collectibles.location: @loc{Bogdo Sinkholes}, end of the cliff ledge
collectibles.method: Continue left along the ledge, jump the gap, and slice the chest.

achievements.description: Defeat four mysterious creatures
achievements.summary: Kill the four legendary creatures.

collectibles.name: Oggdo Bogdo
collectibles.method: Follow the pipes outside the fan room to the cave, or drop through a hole in the plateau above. Kill @enemy{Oggdo Bogdo}.

collectibles.name: Albino Wyyyschokk
collectibles.method: From the meditation point above the stormtrooper and spider fight, follow the upper ledge through the tree-root passage. Drop into the webbed pit and kill @enemy{Albino Wyyyschokk}.

collectibles.name: Rabid Jotaz
collectibles.method: From Crash Site, swim to the island with the Jotaz. Use BD-1’s Overcharge on the nearby console and enter the wreck. Kill @enemy{Rabid Jotaz} in the chamber below.

collectibles.name: Nydak Alpha
collectibles.method: At the stairs into the Tomb of Kujet, turn right onto the root and follow the wall runs to @enemy{Nydak Alpha}. Kill the creature.

achievements.description: Unlock all Jedi skills
achievements.summary: Purchase all 33 Jedi skills.

guide.context: Battle Grid kills award no experience.

steps.text: At meditation points, spend skill points until every node in the Jedi skill tree is purchased. The full tree opens after you learn @mechanic{Jedi Flip} on Kashyyyk.

If points are still needed after the story, use the meditation point at the entrance to @loc{Tomb of Kujet}, Dathomir. Squeeze through the passage and kill the two @enemy{Lesser Nydaks} from the stairs, then rest to respawn them.

achievements.description: Complete all of BD-1's holomaps
achievements.summary: Reach 100% exploration on all five planetary holomaps.

steps.text: Check exploration percentages on the holomap for @loc{Bogano}, @loc{Zeffo}, @loc{Kashyyyk}, @loc{Dathomir}, and @loc{Ilum}. Select each unfinished region to narrow the search.
Walk every remaining branch, including empty alcoves and slides. Collecting all chests does not by itself guarantee 100% exploration.

At @loc{Origin Tree} on Kashyyyk, find the wall run beside the lower clearing with the Slyyyg, spiders, and Mushbloom seed. Scan the discarded @item{Wookiee Horn} on the ground to the right of the wall run; this scan adds 1% exploration.

achievements.description: Finish Cal’s story.
achievements.summary: Finish Cal’s story.

steps.text: Finish the mission at @loc{Fortress Inquisitorius} and escape to reach the ending.

achievements.description: Join the Mantis crew after escaping Bracca.
achievements.summary: Join the Mantis crew after escaping Bracca.

steps.text: Survive the Second Sister encounter at the end of the @loc{Bracca} prologue until the Mantis rescues Cal.

achievements.description: Discover the Ancient Vault on Bogano.
achievements.summary: Discover the Ancient Vault on Bogano.

steps.text: Reach the @loc{Ancient Vault} on Bogano and scan the central stone circle with BD-1 to view Cordova’s message.

achievements.description: Finish the Tomb of Eilram on Zeffo.
achievements.summary: Finish the Tomb of Eilram on Zeffo.

steps.text: Solve the sphere puzzles in @loc{Tomb of Eilram}, then ride the lift back to the surface.

achievements.description: Finish the Tomb of Miktrull on Zeffo.
achievements.summary: Finish the Tomb of Miktrull on Zeffo.

steps.text: Break the hanging sphere container in @loc{Tomb of Miktrull}, place the sphere in its socket, and raise the spire to view Cordova’s message.

achievements.description: Open Bogano’s vault with the Astrium.
achievements.summary: Open Bogano’s vault with the Astrium.

steps.text: Place the @item{Astrium} in the central console inside Bogano’s @loc{Ancient Vault}.

achievements.description: Free the imprisoned Wookiees on Kashyyyk.
achievements.summary: Free Kashyyyk’s imprisoned Wookiees and win the rooftop battle against the Imperial forces.

steps.text: Free the Wookiees in @loc{Imperial Refinery} and win the rooftop battle with Saw Gerrera, including the AT-ST.

achievements.description: Defeat the Ninth Sister on Kashyyyk.
achievements.summary: Defeat the Ninth Sister on Kashyyyk.

steps.text: Defeat the @enemy{Ninth Sister} at @loc{Chieftain’s Canopy} on your return to Kashyyyk.

achievements.description: Explore the Venator wreck on Zeffo.
achievements.summary: Reach the far exit of the crashed Venator on Zeffo.

steps.text: After learning @mechanic{Jedi Flip} on Kashyyyk, return to Zeffo’s @loc{Crash Site}. Climb the grating near the Jotaz island and continue upward into the Venator’s upper engine.
Slide into @loc{Venator Wreckage}, complete the route through the ship, and emerge from the far exit.

achievements.description: Defeat Gorgara on Dathomir.
achievements.summary: Defeat Gorgara on Dathomir.

steps.text: Fight @enemy{Gorgara} in @loc{Witches Horn}, then finish the later aerial encounter while climbing out.

achievements.description: Build Cal’s new lightsaber on Ilum.
achievements.summary: Build Cal’s new lightsaber on Ilum.

steps.text: Recover the kyber crystal in @loc{Crystal Caves} on Ilum and rebuild Cal’s lightsaber.

achievements.displayName: I Knew He Was No Good
achievements.description: Defeat Taron Malicos on Dathomir.
achievements.summary: Defeat Taron Malicos on Dathomir.

steps.text: Return to @loc{Tomb of Kujet} on Dathomir after Ilum and defeat @enemy{Taron Malicos}.

achievements.description: Defeat 50 enemies with reflected blaster bolts
achievements.summary: Kill 50 enemies by reflecting their blaster bolts.

steps.text: Tap Block just before a blaster bolt hits Cal to reflect it back for a kill. Use the stormtroopers near the @loc{Imperial Refinery} entrance on Kashyyyk, resting at the nearby meditation point when more targets are needed.

achievements.description: Parry 100 enemies
achievements.summary: Perform 100 successful enemy parries.

steps.text: Tap Block just before a melee attack lands. A successful parry staggers the attacker; you can earn all 100 parries against the same @enemy{Scout Trooper} without killing him.

achievements.description: Defeat an enemy using only kicks
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy with kicks as the only source of damage.

steps.text: Buy @mechanic{Evasive Kick} and isolate a full-health stormtrooper. Evade without moving, then press Attack immediately to kick. Keep using kicks until the trooper dies; do not damage him with the lightsaber.
steps.note: If another attack damages the trooper, choose a different full-health enemy or rest at a meditation point to respawn one.

achievements.description: Defeat 3 enemies using a single lightsaber throw
achievements.summary: Kill three enemies with one lightsaber throw.

steps.text: Buy @mechanic{Lightsaber Throw}. Find the three @enemy{Splox} at the amphitheatre in @loc{Binog Mesa}, Bogano, and let them bunch together.
Use one lightsaber throw to kill the three Splox. If fewer than three die, rest at a meditation point to respawn them and try again.

achievements.description: Defeat an enemy with their own Slowed blaster bolt
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy with that enemy’s own slowed blaster bolt.

steps.text: After learning @mechanic{Force Pull}, buy @mechanic{Grasping Pull}. Face a lone stormtrooper from a distance and use @mechanic{Slow} on a bolt just after he fires.
Hold Pull to drag the shooter into his own suspended bolt. Do not reflect the bolt with your lightsaber.

achievements.description: Defeat 20 enemies with explosives
achievements.summary: Kill 20 enemies with explosions.

steps.text: Use @mechanic{Force Push} to send a rocket back into its @enemy{Rocket Launcher Trooper}. Slow the rocket first if you need more time to aim.
Keep returning rockets until 20 enemies have died to explosions. Rest at meditation points to respawn troopers.

achievements.description: Defeat an enemy with a hacked droid
achievements.summary: Have a hacked droid kill an enemy.

steps.text: In @loc{Imperial Refinery} on Kashyyyk, find the locked door beside the Partisan near the freed Wookiees. Swing across the hanging cables to get behind the door and use the workbench to unlock @mechanic{Slice: Security Droid}.
On the refinery rooftop, damage the Security Droid until BD-1’s Slice prompt appears. Hack the droid and let it kill one of the nearby flametroopers.

achievements.description: Precision Evade 100 attacks
achievements.summary: Use Precision Evade to avoid 100 attacks.

steps.text: After learning @mechanic{Jedi Flip} on Kashyyyk, buy @mechanic{Precision Evade} in the Survival tree.
Face a lone @enemy{Scout Trooper} and evade at the last moment without moving. Look for the brief slowdown and Force recovery. Keep dodging the trooper’s attacks until 100 Precision Evades register.

achievements.description: Send 25 enemies over the edge
achievements.summary: Knock 25 enemies off ledges.

steps.text: Use @mechanic{Force Push} on troopers beside the cliffs near the @loc{Imperial Refinery} entrance on Kashyyyk. Knock 25 enemies into the drop, resting at the nearby meditation point to respawn them.

achievements.description: Defeat 25 enemies while they are under the effect of Empowered Slow
achievements.summary: Kill 25 enemies while Empowered Slow is active on them.

steps.text: Buy @mechanic{Empowered Slow}. Use a weak stormtrooper, or damage a tougher enemy until one lightsaber hit will kill.
Hold Slow until Cal releases the charged pulse, then kill the slowed target with one attack. Do this to 25 enemies; releasing Slow before the pulse will not count.

achievements.description: Defeat an enemy by colliding them with another enemy
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy by slamming another enemy into them.

steps.text: At the @loc{Imperial Refinery} entrance on Kashyyyk, follow the fleeing black astromech until a Scout Trooper lines up behind it. Use @mechanic{Force Push} to launch the droid into the trooper for a lethal collision.

achievements.description: Strike one enemy with each of the three lightsaber attack types.
achievements.summary: Hit one enemy with single-bladed, double-bladed, and split-saber attacks.

steps.text: After rebuilding the lightsaber on Ilum, find a @enemy{Security Droid} in @loc{Imperial Trench}. Hit that same droid with a single-bladed strike, a double-bladed strike, and a @mechanic{Split Saber} attack before killing it.

achievements.description: Slice an oggdo's tongue
achievements.summary: Sever an oggdo’s tongue with the lightsaber.

steps.text: Buy @mechanic{Grasping Pull} after learning Force Pull. Find an @enemy{Oggdo} below the meditation point in Bogano’s @loc{Subterranean Refuge}.
Lock on and hold Pull to draw out the oggdo’s tongue, then strike the tongue with your lightsaber. If you kill the oggdo first, rest at the meditation point to respawn it.

achievements.description: Find all of BD-1's stim canisters
achievements.summary: Collect all eight stim-canister upgrades for BD-1.

guide.context: BD-1 starts with two stims; collecting these upgrades raises the capacity to ten.

collectibles.name: Landing Pad stim
collectibles.method: Go down the spiral ramp. Push the sphere along the curved concrete ramp into its socket behind the bars, then open the gold chest.

collectibles.name: Subterranean Refuge stim
collectibles.location: Upper ledge beside the wall runs
collectibles.method: Use the wall runs from the meditation point to reach the upper level. Pull down the stone block above, then climb to the chest.

collectibles.name: Derelict Hangar stim
collectibles.method: Follow the cave near the first Scazz encounter to its dead end and open the gold chest.

collectibles.name: Imperial Dig Site stim
collectibles.method: Take the powered zipline upward from the bridge and drop onto the platform underneath. Follow the pipe and Push through the breakable wall to reach the chest.

collectibles.name: Venator Wreckage stim
collectibles.method: Finish the route through the Venator. Drop down the ledges outside the final room to the gold chest before returning to Crash Site.

collectibles.name: Ice Caves stim
collectibles.location: Across the vines near the lower meditation point
collectibles.method: From the nearby Jotaz, approach the far-left ledge. Pull the hanging vines toward you and swing across to the chest.

collectibles.name: Origin Lake stim
collectibles.location: Above the lung plants beyond the wrecked gunship
collectibles.method: Dive through the narrow underwater passage and the wrecked Republic Gunship. Use the three lung plants across from the vine wall to bounce up to the chest.

collectibles.name: Nightmare Ruins stim
collectibles.location: Root above the Tomb of Kujet entrance
collectibles.method: Take the side route right of the tomb stairs past Nydak Alpha. Follow the wall runs, climb the vine wall, and walk along the high root to the chest.

achievements.description: Have a fully grown terrarium
achievements.summary: Check the Mantis terrarium after all ten plants reach maturity.

guide.context: Scan each seed with BD-1, then plant it by checking the Mantis terrarium. Spend time exploring away from the ship while the plants grow. Inspect the terrarium again once every plant is mature.

collectibles.name: Kalpi
collectibles.method: Drop two levels below the meditation point. Scan the lone stalk in the muddy corner near the Bog Rats.

collectibles.name: Featherfern
collectibles.method: Use Jedi Flip to reach the plateau above the wall-run route. Jump the gap and scan the purple flower at the far end.

collectibles.name: Royal Fluzz
collectibles.location: Weathered Monument: outside the trooper cave
collectibles.method: Leave the cave guarded by a Heavy Assault Trooper. Follow the path left and scan the purple flowers near the locked chest.

collectibles.name: Gillypod
collectibles.location: Windswept Ruins: top of the stairs
collectibles.method: Climb through the phillaks to the highest square platform and scan the small mound there.

collectibles.name: Dreamwort
collectibles.location: Crash Site: island with the circular wreck section
collectibles.method: At the far-right water’s edge of the Jotaz island, scan the plant beside the Scazz burrows.

collectibles.name: Bonshyyyr
collectibles.location: Imperial Refinery: trooper and spider clearing
collectibles.method: From the meditation point above the fight, drop into the muddy clearing. Scan the plant left of the chest.

collectibles.name: Milk Grass
collectibles.location: Gloomroot Hollow: ledge after a jaw plant
collectibles.method: At the path junction, take the left route. Jump over the jaw plant, climb the ledge on the left, and scan the plant.

collectibles.name: Mushbloom
collectibles.method: Climb from the meditation point into the clearing with the Slyyyg and spiders. Stay on this level and scan beneath the lung plant ahead.

collectibles.name: Bleeding Gut
collectibles.location: Swamp of Sacrifice: first landing area
collectibles.method: After sliding down from Nightbrother Village, turn left and scan the plant in the corner against the wall.

collectibles.name: Mushling
collectibles.method: In the lower swamp, find the @item{Power & Control} lightsaber-emitter chest beside the vine wall, near the Lesser Nydak and Undead Nightsisters. Follow the rock wall to the right of that chest, past the Bleeding Gut databank scan, and scan the Mushling seed plant.

achievements.description: Recruit all possible crew members for the Mantis
achievements.summary: Recruit all five Mantis crew members.

steps.text: On Bogano, go down the spiral ramp below the @loc{Landing Pad}. Use @mechanic{Force Push} to break the cracked wall beside the sphere puzzle, then approach the @npc{Bogling} to recruit it.
Complete the Dathomir story after Ilum so @npc{Merrin} joins. Cere, Greez, and BD-1 join during the story.

achievements.description: Find all of BD-1's encrypted logs
achievements.summary: Collect all 19 encrypted logs in Cordova’s Journey.

guide.context: Use the Databank’s Cordova’s Journey section to check missing entries. Seven logs arrive during the story; the other twelve require BD-1 scans.

collectibles.name: Secrets of the Vault
collectibles.method: View Cordova’s first vault message during the story.

collectibles.name: Discovering Dathomir
collectibles.method: Follow the first story route through the workshop to receive the message.

collectibles.name: An Ancient Sphere
collectibles.method: Start on the surface of Bogdo Sinkholes. Pull down the raised bridge and cross to the building above the fan room. Pull the hanging rope toward you, then swing back toward the fan set into the cliff. Slow the fan in midair and jump through. Scan the suspended sphere inside.

collectibles.name: The Premonition
collectibles.method: Use the powered zipline to reach the roof. Enter the upper floor, cut the blocking cables, and scan the rubble in the side room.

collectibles.name: Sage, Vault, & Tomb
collectibles.method: Slow the fan to enter the room and scan the table left of the workbench.

collectibles.name: Acquiring the Holocron
collectibles.location: Abandoned Workshop: room above the flooded chamber
collectibles.method: Dive into the workshop’s lower chamber, climb the vines, and take the stone stairs. Slice the locked door at the landing and scan the Zeffo statues inside.

collectibles.name: The Sages
collectibles.location: Turbine Facility: ledge above the chasm
collectibles.method: At the cave fork, take the right route over the red-lit wall run and the pipe. Scan the open crate on the far side.

collectibles.name: Tomb of Eilram
collectibles.method: Use the central sphere to enter the tomb during the story.

collectibles.name: Old Friend
collectibles.location: Tomb of Eilram: Force Push chamber
collectibles.method: Learn Force Push during the story to receive this message.

collectibles.name: Sage Eilram
collectibles.location: Tomb of Eilram: final puzzle passage
collectibles.method: Place the second sphere in the main chamber’s other socket. Enter the newly opened passage and scan the low-hanging wind chime.

collectibles.name: Magnets
collectibles.location: Tomb of Miktrull: first root barrier
collectibles.method: In the room where the console burns the roots, scan the wall on the left side of the roots.

collectibles.name: Sage Miktrull
collectibles.location: Tomb of Miktrull: side room with Greezy Money chest
collectibles.method: On the upper route outside the main chamber, find the chest near the urn’s Force Echo. Scan the wall in that room.

collectibles.name: The Key to the Vault
collectibles.method: Raise the central spire and view the story message.

collectibles.name: Shyyyo Bird
collectibles.method: During the climb, scan the feathers where the Shyyyo Bird briefly lands in front of Cal.

collectibles.name: Origin Tree
collectibles.location: Origin Tree: ledge above the healed bird
collectibles.method: After healing the bird, climb the ledge and Jedi Flip to the chest. Turn around there and let BD-1 scan the view.

collectibles.name: Astrium
collectibles.method: Follow the story at the top of the Origin Tree to receive the message.

collectibles.name: Kujet’s Tomb
collectibles.method: At the exit from the entry hall, look beside the foot of the staircase. Scan the urn on the right.

collectibles.name: Shrouded In Darkness
collectibles.method: In the main chamber before Malicos, climb the yellow vines on the left to the memorial room. Drop back down, cross the hall, and scan the ashen Zeffo bodies opposite.

collectibles.name: My Friend
collectibles.method: Reunite with BD-1 during the kyber-crystal story sequence.

achievements.description: Fully customize your lightsaber
achievements.summary: Change every lightsaber customization category from its starting option.

steps.text: Use a lightsaber workbench, such as the one aboard the @loc{Mantis}. Select a different Colour, Emitter, Switch, Sleeve, and Material, using parts found in chests.

achievements.description: Customize the look of Cal, BD-1, and the Mantis
achievements.summary: Change Cal’s outfit and poncho, BD-1’s skin, and the Mantis paint job.

steps.text: Open the Customization menu after finding cosmetic items in chests. Equip a new outfit and poncho for Cal, a new BD-1 skin, and a new Mantis paint job.

achievements.description: Scan all enemy types
achievements.summary: Fill all 45 enemy entries in the Tactical Guide.

guide.context: An enemy that falls into a pit before you scan it respawns when you rest. A missed Haxion Brood type comes back in a later random ambush.

collectibles.name: Bog Rat
collectibles.location: @loc{Great Divide}, lower ledge after the zipline
collectibles.method: Kill the lone Bog Rat; this fight unlocks scanning. Scan the corpse with BD-1.

collectibles.name: Oggdo
collectibles.method: Defeat the Oggdo met along the main path. Scan the corpse with BD-1.

collectibles.name: Splox
collectibles.location: @loc{Great Divide}, cliff pass above the elevator shortcut
collectibles.method: Kill one of the three Splox that ambush you. Scan the corpse with BD-1.

collectibles.name: Scazz
collectibles.method: Kill the two Scazz feeding on a stormtrooper. Scan the corpse with BD-1.

collectibles.name: Stormtrooper
collectibles.method: Scan the dead stormtrooper the Scazz were eating.

collectibles.name: Scout Trooper
collectibles.method: Kill one of the patrolling scout troopers. Scan the corpse with BD-1.

collectibles.name: Scout Trooper Commander
collectibles.method: Defeat the commander. Scan the corpse with BD-1.

collectibles.name: Phillak
collectibles.location: @loc{Gusty Bluffs}, past the first slowed turbine
collectibles.method: Kill the phillak. Scan the corpse with BD-1.

collectibles.name: Rocket Launcher Trooper
collectibles.location: @loc{Gusty Bluffs}, raised ledge around the corner
collectibles.method: Kill the trooper without knocking him off the ledge. Scan the corpse with BD-1.

collectibles.name: Stormtrooper Commander
collectibles.method: Defeat the commander leading the trooper group. Scan the corpse with BD-1.

collectibles.name: Heavy Assault Trooper
collectibles.location: @loc{Weathered Monument}, stone bridge on the upper route
collectibles.method: Wall-run left of the Force Push wall, pass the meditation point, and defeat the trooper. Scan the corpse with BD-1.

collectibles.name: Skungus
collectibles.method: Recorded on its own when you squeeze past the second Skungus.

collectibles.name: Tomb Guardian
collectibles.location: @loc{Tomb of Eilram}, bottom of the main chamber
collectibles.method: Go down from the first meditation point and defeat the guardian at the back. Scan the corpse with BD-1.

collectibles.name: Jotaz
collectibles.method: Defeat the Jotaz that smashes through the ice wall. Dodge and hit it from behind. Scan the corpse with BD-1.

collectibles.name: Electrobaton Purge Trooper
collectibles.location: @loc{Ice Caves}, upper level right of the elevator
collectibles.method: Cut the cable shortcut, go right around the elevator, and wall-run up. Defeat the purge trooper. Scan the corpse with BD-1.

collectibles.name: AT-ST
collectibles.method: Destroy the AT-ST boss. Its entry records on its own; the pilot does not count.

collectibles.name: Wyyyschokk
collectibles.method: Take the side route past the breakable pipes and drop into the mud. Kill the spider that attacks. Scan the corpse with BD-1.

collectibles.name: Flame Beetle
collectibles.location: @loc{Forest Trench}, after the rotating wall run
collectibles.method: Kill one of the two beetles on the way to Saw Gerrera. Scan the corpse with BD-1.

collectibles.name: Electrostaff Purge Trooper
collectibles.method: Defeat the purge trooper. Scan the corpse with BD-1.

collectibles.name: Flametrooper
collectibles.location: @loc{Imperial Refinery}, room past the open vent
collectibles.method: Kill one of the two flametroopers fighting beetles. Scan the corpse with BD-1.

collectibles.name: Albino Wyyyschokk
collectibles.method: Drop into the pit to fight it. Recorded when you win or die in the fight.

collectibles.name: Slyyyg
collectibles.location: @loc{Imperial Refinery}, left fork of the underbrush maze
collectibles.method: Cross the pipe into the maze and go left. Kill the Slyyyg. Scan the corpse with BD-1.

collectibles.name: Security Droid
collectibles.location: @loc{Imperial Refinery}, boss room through the left door
collectibles.method: Defeat the boss. If it never reappears after a death, quit to the main menu and reload.

collectibles.name: Rabid Jotaz
collectibles.method: Fight the Rabid Jotaz. Recorded when you win or die in the fight.

collectibles.name: Probe Droid
collectibles.method: Destroy a probe droid, then scan the ground where it exploded.

collectibles.name: The Second Sister
collectibles.method: Fight the surprise boss. Recorded when you win or die in the fight.

collectibles.name: Purge Trooper Commander
collectibles.location: @loc{Imperial Headquarters}, room below the sliced door
collectibles.method: Before the elevator out, slice the door in that room and jump down. Defeat the commander. Scan the corpse with BD-1.

collectibles.name: Haxion Brood Bounty Hunter
collectibles.method: Defeat the bounty hunter who captured you and scan the corpse. If the entry stays empty, scan one in a later random ambush.

collectibles.name: Mykal
collectibles.method: Kill the Mykal released when you pull the bridge down. Scan the corpse with BD-1.

collectibles.name: Jaw Plant
collectibles.method: Scan the snapping plant.

collectibles.name: Saava
collectibles.location: @loc{Shadowlands}, across the pool in the first area
collectibles.method: Scan the dead Saava flower.

collectibles.name: Electrohammer Purge Trooper
collectibles.method: Defeat him without pushing him off a ledge; few appear in the game. Scan the corpse with BD-1.

collectibles.name: The Ninth Sister
collectibles.method: Fight the Ninth Sister. Recorded when you win or die in the fight.

collectibles.name: Haxion Brood Commando
collectibles.method: Defeat the commando in a random boss-style ambush. Scan the corpse with BD-1.

collectibles.name: Haxion Brood Bounty Droid
collectibles.method: Sometimes joins a commando or bounty hunter ambush. Destroy it and scan the remains.

collectibles.name: Bane Back Spider
collectibles.method: Kill one of the common spiders. Scan the corpse with BD-1.

collectibles.name: Lesser Nydak
collectibles.method: Kill the patrolling Nydak. Scan the corpse with BD-1.

collectibles.name: Nightbrother Warrior
collectibles.location: @loc{Upper Strangled Cliffs}, first meeting with Merrin
collectibles.method: Kill one of the two warriors Merrin sends. Scan the corpse with BD-1.

collectibles.name: Nightbrother Archer
collectibles.location: @loc{Brother's Bastion}, steps past the meditation point
collectibles.method: Kill one of the two archers in the ambush. Scan the corpse with BD-1.

collectibles.name: Undead Nightsister
collectibles.location: @loc{Collapsed Settlement}, narrow passage past the meditation point
collectibles.method: Kill one of the three Merrin summons. Scan the corpse with BD-1.

collectibles.name: Gorgara
collectibles.method: Fight Gorgara. Recorded when you win or die in the fight.

collectibles.name: Nydak Alpha
collectibles.method: Fight the Nydak Alpha. Recorded when you win or die in the fight.

collectibles.name: Taron Malicos
collectibles.method: Fight Taron Malicos. Recorded when you win or die in the fight.

collectibles.name: Oggdo Bogdo
collectibles.method: Fight Oggdo Bogdo. Recorded when you win or die in the fight.

collectibles.name: Darth Vader
collectibles.location: After the final fight with Trilla
collectibles.method: Escape the story encounter; the entry records on its own.

achievements.description: Defeat all three bounty-hunter enemy types.
achievements.summary: Kill each of the three Haxion Brood bounty-hunter types.

steps.text: After escaping the @loc{Haxion Fight Pit}, kill the three ambush types: @enemy{Haxion Brood Commando}, @enemy{Haxion Brood Bounty Hunter}, and @enemy{Haxion Brood Bounty Droid}.
Revisit explored areas and former boss arenas on the planets to find more ambushes until you have killed each type. Scan their bodies for Data Collector before moving on.

achievements.description: Discover 75 Force Echoes
achievements.summary: Collect 75 Force Echoes.

steps.text: Approach glowing blue objects or remains and use Cal’s Force Echo prompt. Collect echoes while exploring the planets and picking up life and Force essences until the total reaches 75.
